description: Validate ONE document you hand over — a vendor declaration, supplier catalogue, request, quote or UCP manifest (its `schema` field says which) — against the published JSON Schema, the vocabulary (every term URI must exist; deprecated warns) and, for request/1 and quote/1, the identity: the spec and request fingerprints are recomputed from the configuration and must match what the document states; a quote's offer fingerprint must equal request + the quote's vendor (SD-0108). Nothing is fetched from any domain and nothing is stored. This is the PTPGE Ready conformance check for a module that writes these documents (ptpge.org/ready/). Returns valid, errors[], warnings[] and what was checked.

document.description: The document itself (JSON object with a `schema` field).

name: ptpge_validate_document
title: Validate a PTPGE document
